title: ulana-nf pipeline parameters
description: Bacterial whole-genome assembly and characterization from Oxford Nanopore long reads: Flye assembly, optional Medaka polishing, Prokka annotation, CheckM QC, marker-gene extraction, and AMRFinderPlus AMR detection, with optional GenBank submission files.

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV with columns sample,fastq, plus organism,strain,locus_tag for GenBank submission files.
input.help_text: Each row maps a sample name to a fastq(.gz) file or glob. A glob may match multiple part-files -- they're merged into one file per sample before filtering. Glob paths resolve relative to the launch directory, not the samplesheet's own location. The organism, strain and locus_tag columns are only read with --enable_genbank, which needs organism (genus and species, or 'Genus sp.' with a strain) and locus_tag (the prefix NCBI assigns when the BioSample is registered) on every row.

outdir.description: Output directory where results are published.

enable_read_stats.description: Summarize read length and Q-score before vs. after filtering.
enable_read_stats.help_text: Writes read_qc_summary.html, read_stats.tsv and read_length_qscore_hist.tsv to read_qc/. Purely informational -- nothing downstream depends on it.

downsampling.title: Downsampling
downsampling.description: Subsample very deep samples before assembly.

enable_downsampling.description: Subsample each sample's filtered reads to --target_coverage before assembly.
enable_downsampling.help_text: Flye fails on very deep data (a ~91 kb phage at ~5,000x gave 'No disjointigs were assembled'). Reads are picked at random with Rasusa, so plasmids keep their share. A sample below the target keeps every filtered read. Flye and Medaka both use the subsampled reads; {sample}/reads/{sample}.downsampling.tsv records the depth before and after. If Flye still fails on depth (the genome size couldn't be estimated, or was far off), it retries once on a share of the reads sized from its own coverage measurement; {sample}/assembly/flye/flye_reads.tsv records that.

target_coverage.description: Depth to subsample to (x genome size).
target_coverage.help_text: Samples with more than this many bases per genome base are cut to it; samples with less are left alone.

genome_size.description: Expected genome size, e.g. 92kb or 5.5mb. Leave blank to estimate it.
genome_size.help_text: Used to turn --target_coverage into a number of bases. Left blank, LRGE estimates each sample's genome size from its reads (it tends to guess high, which means less subsampling, not more). Set it when every sample in the run has roughly the same genome size. If the estimate fails, that sample keeps every read.

flye_mode.help_text: --nano-hq for modern high-accuracy basecalling (Guppy5+/Dorado SUP), --nano-raw for older/lower-accuracy reads, --nano-corr for pre-corrected reads.

assembly_graph_image.title: Assembly graph image
assembly_graph_image.description: Bandage rendering of the Flye assembly graph.

enable_bandage.description: Render a PNG of the Flye assembly graph with Bandage.
enable_bandage.help_text: Runs directly off the Flye GFA, so it's unaffected by --enable_medaka (Medaka polishes sequence, not graph topology).

bandage_height.description: Output image height in pixels (width is scaled automatically).

polishing.title: Polishing
polishing.description: Medaka polishing of the Flye assembly.

enable_medaka.description: Polish the Flye assembly with Medaka.
enable_medaka.help_text: When enabled, every downstream step (Prokka/CheckM/AMRFinder/id_genes) consumes the Medaka-polished assembly instead of the raw Flye assembly.

medaka_model.help_text: Must match the basecaller/flowcell/chemistry combination used to generate the reads -- see `medaka tools list_models`.

enable_prokka.help_text: Required by --enable_id_genes and --enable_amrfinder, which both consume Prokka's output.

identifier_genes.title: Identifier genes
identifier_genes.description: Marker gene extraction from Prokka output.

enable_id_genes.description: Extract 16S rRNA, dnaA, and rpoB sequences from the Prokka annotation.

enable_amrfinder.description: Run AMRFinderPlus on the annotated assembly.
enable_amrfinder.help_text: Requires --enable_prokka. The AMRFinderPlus database is downloaded fresh at the start of every run.

species_check.title: Species check
species_check.description: How close each genome is to the nearest named species (NCBI type strains).

enable_species_check.description: Compare each assembly with NCBI's bacterial type-strain genomes (skani ANI), and its 16S copies with NCBI's 16S type-strain database.
enable_species_check.help_text: Writes {sample}/species_check/: genome_hits.tsv (closest type strains by ANI and aligned fraction), 16S_hits.tsv (needs --enable_id_genes) and typestrain_db.json (which snapshot was searched). No verdict is written; about 95-96% ANI to a type strain is the usual same-species line. Needs --species_db; without one the step is skipped with a warning.

species_db.description: Type-strain snapshot folder (local path or gs://) built by scripts/build_typestrain_db.py.
species_db.help_text: Holds sketch/ (skani database), typestrains.tsv, build_info.json and 16S/ (BLAST database), plus lineage.tsv and gtotree_hmms/ for the species tree. The google_batch profile points this at the project's copy; the full snapshot is about 51 GB.

enable_species_tree.description: Draw a marker-gene tree of each assembly with its closest type strains (GToTree + IQ-TREE), with support values.
enable_species_tree.help_text: Writes {sample}/species_check/tree/: neighbours.tsv (the type strains used: up to 10, one per species except the closest species keeps all its type strains; from the genome hits first, then 16S hits when there are few or none), tree.nwk (UFBoot support at each fork), tree_report.txt, ani.tsv (pairwise ANI between them) and tree_info.json (marker set, model, or why no tree was drawn). Needs --enable_species_check and a snapshot with lineage.tsv and gtotree_hmms/. Adds roughly 5-15 minutes per sample.

genbank_submission.title: GenBank submission
genbank_submission.description: Files for submitting the annotated genome to GenBank.

enable_genbank.description: Prepare GenBank submission files from the Prokka annotation.
enable_genbank.help_text: Requires --enable_prokka and the samplesheet's organism and locus_tag columns. Fixes what NCBI's validator rejects in Prokka's output, then runs table2asn to build the .sqn to upload, a GenBank flatfile to read it in, and NCBI's validation and discrepancy reports. Writes genbank/ per sample; submission_info.txt lists what changed and what to enter in NCBI's Genome Submission Portal.

genbank_template.description: NCBI submission template (.sbt) with the submitter and authors.
genbank_template.help_text: Made with NCBI's form at https://submit.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/genbank/template/submission/. Optional: without it the .sqn has no submitter or citation, and the validation report lists that as its two errors.

generic_options.title: Generic options
generic_options.description: Less common options, typically left at their defaults.

help.description: Display the help message and exit.

tracedir.description: Directory for the Nextflow timeline/report/trace files.

container_images.title: Container images
container_images.description: Where each tool's container image is pulled from.

container_registry.description: Registry for the biocontainers images (amrfinderplus, bandage, checkm, chopper, flye, pandas, prokka).
container_registry.help_text: The google_batch profile points this at the project's own Artifact Registry mirror (see scripts/mirror_images.sh) so Batch VMs don't pull from quay.io; pass --container_registry quay.io to pull from upstream instead. The mirror keeps each image's upstream path, so only the host changes.

dockerhub_registry.description: Registry for the Docker Hub images (medaka, and ubuntu for merging reads, identifier genes and on Batch).
dockerhub_registry.help_text: Same idea as container_registry, for images that come from Docker Hub.
